basic_info.description: This handsome four-unit property on a tranquil block of Corona Heights boasts spectacular views from every unit.  Lovingly maintained by the same owner for many years, the building has a desirable unit mix of three one-bedroom units and one studio. A vacant one-bedroom unit has been beautifully updated allowing a new owner to secure today's strong market rents from tenants seeking this ideal location near the shops and restaurants of the Castro and Cole Valley.  A great opportunity for both savvy investors and owner-occupants, the building has individual meters for gas and electricity, keeping operating costs low.   This desirable property is completed by a garage and laundry area.
